13883-the-tree-of-heaven.title: The Tree Of Heaven
13883-the-tree-of-heaven.creator: May Sinclair
13883-the-tree-of-heaven.description: A book by May Sinclair. Frances had a tranquil nature and she never worried. But as she sat under her tree of Heaven a thought came that made a faint illusion of worry for her mind. She had forgotten to ask Grannie and Auntie Louie and Auntie Emmeline and Auntie Edie to tea.

arxiv-1812-07986.title: Editors:
arxiv-1812-07986.creator: J. de Blas
arxiv-1812-07986.description: Abstract The Compact Linear Collider, CLIC, is a proposed e + ​ e − \mathup{{{\mathup{{{e}}}}}^{\scriptstyle{+}}}\mathup{{{\mathup{{{e}}}}}^{\scriptstyle{-}}} collider at the TeV scale whose physics potential ranges from high-precision measurements to extensive direct sensitivity to physics beyond the Standard Model. This document summarises the physics potential of CLIC, obtained in detailed studies, many based on full simulation of the CLIC detector.

arxiv-2104-08292.title: Capturing the physics of MaNGA galaxies with self-supervised Machine Learning Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2104-08292.creator: Regina Sarmiento, Marc Huertas-Company, Johan H. Knapen, Sebastián F. Sánchez, Helena Domínguez Sánchez, Niv Drory, Jesus Falcón-Barroso
arxiv-2104-08292.description: Abstract As available data sets grow in size and complexity, advanced visualization tools enabling their exploration and analysis become more important. In modern astronomy, integral field spectroscopic galaxy surveys are a clear example of increasing dimensionality and complexity of datasets, which challenge the traditional methods used to extract the physical information they contain.

arxiv-2105-13730.title: Classifying decomposition and wavelet coorbit spaces using coarse geometry
arxiv-2105-13730.creator: Hartmut Führ, René Koch
arxiv-2105-13730.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Hartmut Führ, René Koch. This paper is concerned with the study of Besov-type decomposition spaces, which are scales of spaces associated to suitably defined coverings of the euclidean space ℝ d \mathbb{R}^{d} , or suitable open subsets thereof. A fundamental problem in this domain, that is currently not fully understood, is deciding when two different coverings give rise to the same scale of decomposition spaces.

arxiv-2203-10486.title: Understanding Bulk-Bitwise Processing In-Memory Through Database Analytics
arxiv-2203-10486.creator: Ben Perach, Ronny Ronen, Benny Kimelfeld, and Shahar Kvatinsky
arxiv-2203-10486.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Ben Perach, Ronny Ronen, Benny Kimelfeld, and Shahar Kvatinsky. Bulk-bitwise processing-in-memory (PIM), where large bitwise operations are performed in parallel by the memory array itself, is an emerging form of computation with the potential to mitigate the memory wall problem. This paper examines the capabilities of bulk-bitwise PIM by constructing PIMDB, a fully-digital system based on memristive stateful logic, utilizing and focusing on in-memory bulk-bitwise operations, designed to accelerate a real-life workload: analytical processing of relational databases.

arxiv-2207-05044.title: Future Neutrino Experiments
arxiv-2207-05044.creator: B. Jamieson on behalf of the Hyper-Kamiokande Collaboration
arxiv-2207-05044.description: Abstract The discovery of neutrino oscillations and the large mixing parameters in the Pontecorvo Maki Nakagawa Sakata matrix has opened a window to search for CP-violation in neutrinos. Two long-baseline neutrino experiments, DUNE and Hyper-Kamiokande, are being prepared in the next decade to search for this CP-violation with intense beams of muon and anti-muon neutrinos.

arxiv-2304-06407.title: Graph-theoretic insights on the constructability of complex entangled states
arxiv-2304-06407.creator: L. Sunil Chandran, Rishikesh Gajjala
arxiv-2304-06407.description: Abstract The most efficient automated way to construct a large class of quantum photonic experiments is via abstract representation of graphs with certain properties. While new directions were explored using Artificial intelligence and SAT solvers to find such graphs, it becomes computationally infeasible to do so as the size of the graph increases.

arxiv-2309-15961.title: Negative Immersions and Finite Height Mappings Thanks: Research supported by NSERC
arxiv-2309-15961.creator: Brahim Abdenbi, Daniel T. Wise
arxiv-2309-15961.description: Abstract . Given a monomorphism Ψ : ℋ → ℱ \Psi:\mathcal{H}\rightarrow\mathcal{F} where ℋ \mathcal{H} is a proper free factor of the free group ℱ \mathcal{F} , we show the associated mapping torus X X of Ψ \Psi has negative immersions iff ℋ \mathcal{H} has finite height in π 1 ​ X \pi_{1}X iff Ψ \Psi is fully irreducible.

arxiv-2311-15867.title: Constraining models of hadronic showers using proton-Oxygen collisions at the LHC involving proton/neutron tagging
arxiv-2311-15867.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by *. The study of hadronic showers, which are produced by cosmic rays penetrating the Earth’s atmosphere, is essential for shedding light on the origins and characteristics of high-energy particles originating from space and reaching our planet. At the Large Hadron Collider at CERN, there are plans to conduct a short run of proton–oxygen collisions in 2025 to refine the modeling of hadronic showers.

arxiv-2401-12615.title: The Role of Sea-ice Processes on the Probability of AMOC Transitions
arxiv-2401-12615.description: Abstract Recent simulations performed with the Community Earth System Model (CESM) have suggested a crucial role of sea-ice processes in AMOC hysteresis behaviour under varying surface freshwater forcing. Here, we further investigate this issue using additional CESM simulations and a novel conceptual ocean-sea-ice box model.

arxiv-2407-06256.title: Bound state-continuum resonance transition in a shallow quantum well
arxiv-2407-06256.creator: Yi Huang, Sankar Das Sarma
arxiv-2407-06256.description: Abstract We show a transition from a bound state to a continuum resonance in a shallow quantum well (QW) by electrostatic gating to bend the conduction band edge. This bound state-continuum resonance (BSCR) transition is particularly relevant in topological quantum computing platforms where shallow InAs QWs are used.

arxiv-2407-11274.title: Private Estimation when Data and Privacy Demands are Correlated
arxiv-2407-11274.creator: Syomantak Chaudhuri, Thomas A. Courtade
arxiv-2407-11274.description: Abstract Differential Privacy (DP) is the current gold-standard for ensuring privacy for statistical queries. Estimation problems under DP constraints appearing in the literature have largely focused on providing equal privacy to all users. We consider the problems of empirical mean estimation for univariate data and frequency estimation for categorical data, both subject to heterogeneous privacy constraints.

arxiv-2509-04143.title: The evolution of trust as a cognitive shortcut in repeated interactions
arxiv-2509-04143.creator: Cedric Perret 1, The Anh Han 2, Elias Fernández Domingos 3,4, Theodor Cimpeanu 5, Simon T. Powers 6
arxiv-2509-04143.description: Abstract 1 Department of Economics, University of Lausanne 2 School Computing, Engineering and Digital Technologies, Teesside University 3 Machine Learning Group, Université libre de Bruxelles 4 AI Lab, Vrije Universiteit Brussel 5 Division of Biological and Environmental Sciences, University of Stirling 6 Division of Computing Science and Mathematics, University of Stirling ⋆ Corresponding author: Simon T. Powers (s.t.powers@stir.ac.

arxiv-2512-12588.title: k k -Entanglement Measure for Multipartite Systems without Convex-Roof Extensions and its Evaluation Thanks: Keywords : multipartite systems, entanglement states, entanglement witnesses, k k -nonseparability, k k -entanglement measures Thanks: PACS numbers : 03.65.Ud, 03.65.Db, 03.67.Mn
arxiv-2512-12588.creator: Jie Guo, Shuyuan Yang, Jinchuan Hou, Xiaofei Qi, Kan He
arxiv-2512-12588.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jie Guo, Shuyuan Yang, Jinchuan Hou, Xiaofei Qi, Kan He. Multipartite entanglement underpins quantum technologies but its study is limited by the lack of universal measures, unified frameworks, and the intractability of convex-roof extensions. We establish an axiomatic framework and introduce the first true k k -entanglement measure, E w ( k , n ) E_{w}^{(k,n)} , which satisfies all axioms, establishes k k -entanglement as a multipartite quantum resource, avoids convex-roof constructions, and is efficiently computable.

arxiv-2602-19376.title: Insight into high-entropy effect in body-centered cubic superconducting alloys
arxiv-2602-19376.creator: Hanabusa Senga, Yuto Watanabe, Fubuki Iwase, Ryo Masuda, Daichi Kawahara, Toshiki Haruyama, Terukazu Nishizaki, Yoshikazu Mizuguchi, Jiro Kitagawa
arxiv-2602-19376.description: Abstract We have characterized the superconducting critical temperature ( T c T_{\mathrm{c}} ), the Debye temperature ( θ D \theta_{\mathrm{D}} ), the electronic specific heat coefficient, and the Vickers microhardness of HfNbTiVZr, NbTiZr, HfNbTi, HfNbZr, and HfNbTa, all possessing a body-centered cubic (bcc) structure.

gao-gaoreports-gao-08-20.creator: U.S. Government Accountability Office
gao-gaoreports-gao-08-20.description: Military Base Realignments and Closures: Impact of Terminating, Relocating, or Outsourcing the Services of the Armed Forces Institute of Pathology (2007).

pmc-10506234.title: Retinal functional and structural changes in patients with Parkinson’s disease
pmc-10506234.creator: Rehab Elanwar, Hatem Al Masry, Amna Ibrahim, Mona Hussein, Sahar Ibrahim, Mohammed M Masoud
pmc-10506234.description: BackgroundVisual dysfunction have been well reported as one of the non-motor symptoms in Parkinson’s disease (PD). The aim of this study was to evaluate the functional and structural changes in the retina in patients with PD, and to correlate these changes with disease duration and motor dysfunction.

pmc-10612003.title: Commercially Available Mobile Apps With Family Behavioral Goal Setting and Tracking for Parents: Review and Quality Evaluation
pmc-10612003.creator: Summer Joy Weber, Shelagh A Mulvaney, Anthony Faiola, Madeline Brown, Tatsuki Koyama, Lili Sun, Susanna Lynn Goggans, Pamela Carmen Hull, Sherif Badawy, Kayla Nuss, Beenish Chaudhry, Dana Albright
pmc-10612003.description: BackgroundGoal setting and tracking are well established behavior change techniques. Little is known about the extent to which commercially available mobile apps are designed to guide parents in using these strategies, their evidence base, and their quality.ObjectiveThis study aims to review commercially available apps that target parents in relation to setting and tracking behavioral goals for their children.

pmc-11360211.title: Heat Flow Estimation in Polymer Films during Orientational Drawing at the Local Heater
pmc-11360211.creator: Liubov Myasnikova, Yuri Kurakin, Vladimir Hilarov, Vyacheslav Marikhin, Maria Narykova, Elena Ivan’kova, Alberto García-Peñas
pmc-11360211.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The optimization of the process of polymer film orientational drawing using the local heater was investigated. One of the problems with this technology is that the strength of the resulting fibers differs significantly from the theoretical estimates.

pmc-11427291.title: Rhizobacterial diversity, community composition, and the influence of keystone taxa on O’Neal blueberry (Vaccinium corymbosum)
pmc-11427291.creator: Mingyun Jia, Zhuangzhuang Liu, Jiguang Wei, Qi Li, Zhaoqi Hou, Ling Sun, Hong Yu, Jinping Yu, Shipeng Lu
pmc-11427291.description: Rhizosphere microbiotas play vital roles in resisting environmental stress, transforming soil nutrients, and promoting plant health, growth, and productivity. The effects of rhizosphere microbial community shaping and the characteristics and functions of keystone taxa on blueberries were comprehensively studied by examining the rhizobacteria of healthy old trees (O), young seedlings (OG), and poorly growing seedlings (OB) of O’Neal blueberries.

pmc-11516807.title: Maternal health in conflict-affected settings: a case study from a frozen conflict zone
pmc-11516807.creator: A Agopian, L Musheghyan, Z Sargsyan, D Abrahamian, A Dorian
pmc-11516807.description: BackgroundReproductive, maternal, newborn and child health are negatively impacted in conflict-affected settings, and may be acutely affected in frozen conflicts due to fragile health systems and uncertain geopolitical contexts. To better understand maternal health in a frozen conflict zone, we examined maternal health outcomes in Nagorno-Karabakh during a ceasefire period prior to the forced displacement of the entire population.

pmc-11697553.title: The relationship between thigh circumference and sarcopenia in Chinese community-dwelling elderly aged ≥60 years
pmc-11697553.creator: Zhiwei Zhang, Qianwen Yang, Panpan He, Xiaoming Liu, Xuejiao Zeng, Xueqian Mao, Xueyi Jin, Ying Hu, Lipeng Jing
pmc-11697553.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundThere has been a growing body of research demonstrating that thigh circumference is closely associated with the development of various chronic disease. However, limited evidence has been obtained regarding the relationship between thigh circumference and sarcopenia.ObjectiveThe aim of this study was to investigate the relationship between thigh circumference and sarcopenia, and explore the potential role of thigh circumference for sarcopenia screening among community-dwelling older adults.MethodsThe investigation was carried out in six rural communities located in northwestern China with participants aged ≥60 years

pmc-12433136.title: Lower r-FEV1 as a predictor of treatment response and survival in NSCLC patients receiving neoadjuvant immunochemotherapy
pmc-12433136.creator: Yuqi Lin, Yan Zhang, Yang Pan, Xuanhong Jin, Feng Li, Junnan Ru, Jingwei Lin, Jiandong Hong, Zixuan Fei, Taobo Luo, Liang Shi, Leilei Wu, Jian Zeng
pmc-12433136.description: BackgroundAlthough neoadjuvant immunochemotherapy (nICT) demonstrates considerable promise in improving survival rates for patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), responses among individual patients can vary significantly, and not all patients attain optimal therapeutic outcomes. Our research seeks to discover a simple and cost-effective indicator for the dynamic evaluation of NSCLC patients’ responses to nICT.

pmc-12519166.title: Identification of antigen-specific functional CD8+ T cells using an optofluidic system independent of epitope information
pmc-12519166.creator: Wei Zhang, Yu Liu, Hongxiang Zeng, Xuejiao Liao, Juanjuan Zhao, Xian Tang, Zheng Zhang
pmc-12519166.description: SummaryMost studies detect and isolate antigen-specific CD8+ T cells solely by measuring T cell receptor (TCR) binding affinity to peptide-major histocompatibility complexes (p-MHCs) without considering T cell function. Here, we present a function-based strategy to screen antigen-specific CD8+ T cells using the Lightning optofluidic platform, named MicroFAST (microfluidic function-based screening of antigen-specific single T lymphocyte) fitting for limited sample volume.

pmc-12650982.title: Wnt5a Regulates Focal Adhesion Formation to Promote Migration in Ewing Sarcoma
pmc-12650982.creator: Alissa Baker, Anusha Singhal, Sarah Jacobson, David M Loeb, Günther HS Richter
pmc-12650982.description: Simple SummaryEwing sarcoma is the second most common bone tumor in children, adolescents and young adults. Over the last three decades, the five-year survival rate for metastatic Ewing sarcoma has not improved, highlighting the need to better understand the mechanisms driving metastasis. Wnt signaling has been implicated in driving migration, invasion, and metastasis in various cancers.

pmc-12651934.title: Telehealth Delivery of Speech–Language Pathology Services for Children with Cleft Palate and Velopharyngeal Dysfunction: A Systematic Review
pmc-12651934.creator: Nisreen Naser Al Awaji, Alanoud Nawaf Alsinan, Raja S. Alamri, Nourah A. Bin Ruaydan, Lama S. Alharbi, Lana T. Albesher, Latifa Alrutaiq
pmc-12651934.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background/Objectives: This systematic review aimed to evaluate the effectiveness, caregiver satisfaction, and accessibility of telehealth-delivered speech–language pathology (SLP) services for children with cleft palate and/or velopharyngeal dysfunction (VPD). Methods: Based on PRISMA 2020, we searched PubMed, CINAHL, Scopus, PsycINFO, and the Cochrane Library (2000–31 May 2025) for studies enrolling participants ≤ 18 years of age with cleft/VPD who received telehealth services (assessment, therapy, counseling/follow-up), with or without in-person comparators. Screening and data extraction were performed in duplicate.

pmc-12661296.title: Retrospective cohort study of Gram-negative bacteraemia shows transmission of hypervirulent Klebsiella pneumoniae in a UK Intensive Care Unit during the Covid-19 pandemic
pmc-12661296.creator: Rachel Bousfield, Ruth Kappeler, Sumita Pai, Olly Allen, Kathy Randall, Jacqueline Keane, Stephen Baker
pmc-12661296.description: BackgroundThe National incidence of bloodstream infection (BSI) caused by Klebsiella Pneumoniae increased during the Covid-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom, whilst we observed an increase in BSI caused by Gram-negative bacteria in our adult Intensive Care Unit (ICU).MethodsWe audited all Gram-negative bacterial BSIs between 13th April 2020 and 25th December 2021 in our ICU.

pmc-13075698.title: Time to sputum culture conversion, treatment outcomes, and associated factors among rifampicin-resistant or multidrug-resistant tuberculosis patients in the Sidama region, Ethiopia: A retrospective follow-up study
pmc-13075698.creator: Wolde Abreham Geda, Kebede Tefera Betru, Tarekegn Solomon, Solomon Daniel, Pedro Eduardo Almeida da Silva, Frederick Quinn, Frederick Quinn, Frederick Quinn
pmc-13075698.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundTime to sputum culture conversion is critical for follow-up treatment effectiveness in multidrug-resistant tuberculosis patients. However, the evidence regarding time to culture conversion, treatment outcomes, and the associated factors was sparse and inconsistent.ObjectiveThis study aimed to determine the time to culture conversion, treatment outcomes, and associated factors among rifampicin-resistant and multidrug-resistant tuberculosis cases in the Sidama region from April 1 to December 31, 2024.MethodsWe conducted a retrospective follow-up study of 346 patients who enrolled between January 2013 and June 2024.

pmc-13084416.title: Phytic Acid/ADP Interfacial Assembly for Flame Retardancy and Self-Extinguishment in Cellulose Paper
pmc-13084416.creator: Yangli Cui, Haoran Jiang, Yong Hu, Song Kong, Chuanwen Sun, Feifei Yin
pmc-13084416.description: ADP-P@Mn and ADP-P@Ni composites were prepared by the interfacial assembly of ammonium dihydrogen phosphate (ADP) with transition metal–phytic acid (PA) complexes. These composites were then mixed with cellulose fibers in an aqueous solution to produce flame-retardant paper. Morphological analysis revealed that the original ADP particles exhibited a smooth, cubic morphology; however, after functionalization with phytic acid, the particles became rougher.

pmc-13279458.title: Thorough QT/QTc Clinical Study to Evaluate the Effect of Remdesivir on Cardiac Repolarization in Healthy Participants
pmc-13279458.creator: Chi‐Chi Peng, Ran Duan, Mazin Abdelghany, Santosh Davies, Deqing Xiao, Anna Kwan, Ana Ruiz‐Garcia
pmc-13279458.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). QT interval prolongation associated with drug administration is an important consideration in drug development. Patients with COVID‐19 are at increased risk for cardiac complications, and QT interval prolongation correlates with higher mortality.

pmc-13320532.title: Molecular residual disease-based novel modality of postoperative management for non-small-cell lung cancer (REMODEL): Protocol for a prospective multicenter study
pmc-13320532.creator: Xiaoqiu Yuan, Ruoyi Jin, Yunchu Wei, Yue He, Lin Weng, Zifan Li, Jun Aiden Wang, Xinrui Li, Junnan Xu, Jian Bai, Yun Wang, Qingna Zhang, Na Zhou, Yanyan Hou, Guangxi Wang, Jiatao Zhang, Rong Yin, Ziming Li, Yun Li, Fan Yang, Jun Wang, Kezhong Chen, On behalf of the REMODEL Study
pmc-13320532.description: Background and ObjectivesCirculating tumor DNA (ctDNA)-based molecular residual disease (MRD) has been confirmed to predict postoperative recurrence of early-stage non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC), outperforming conventional imaging modalities by improving diagnostic efficiency and eliminating radiation-related risks. Integrating ctDNA with other liquid biopsy omics methods might further increase monitoring accuracy.

pmc-13332672.title: Endocarditis Masquerading as Malignancy
pmc-13332672.creator: Vlad S Shusterman, Gidon Salamatbad, Andrew Cyr, Yisrael Wallach, Alexander Carlin, Christine Yen, Eileen Kim, Andrew Galmer
pmc-13332672.description: BackgroundHACEK (Haemophilus, Aggregatibacter, Cardiobacterium, Eikenella, Kingella) endocarditis is a rare cause of subacute infective endocarditis typically occurring in patients with pre-existing valvular pathology or structural heart disease.Case SummaryA 65-year-old male presented with months of night sweats, fevers, anemia, and weight loss concerning for malignancy. Transthoracic echocardiography was negative for vegetations.

pmc-13573822.title: Digitally Adapting LGBTQ-Affirmative Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Chinese Men Who Have Sex With Men Living With HIV: User-Centered Design Approach
pmc-13573822.creator: Weizi Wu, Xiaohan Song, John Pachankis, Mengyao Yi, Mengshu Li, Si Pan, Ying He, Fei Li, Yang Xiong, Xianhong Li, Amaryllis Mavragani
pmc-13573822.description: BackgroundChinese men who have sex with men living with HIV (MSMLWH) experience substantial psychological distress driven by minority stress and HIV-related challenges. However, culturally tailored digital mental health interventions that address HIV-specific maladaptive cognitive schemas and culturally specific psychosocial stressors remain scarce in China.

pmc-13660764.title: The Use of Cannabidiol in Cutaneous Wound Healing: A Systematic Review
pmc-13660764.creator: João Henrique Ferreira França, Renale Beserra de Melo Freitas, Geovanne Lucas Rodrigues Rosendo, Mariana Pereira Carvalho, Glicia Maria de Oliveira, Júlio César Claudino dos Santos, Fernanda das Chagas Angelo Mendes Tenorio, Jaiurte Gomes Martins da Silva
pmc-13660764.description: Cutaneous wounds represent a significant health problem due to their high prevalence, functional impact, and effects on quality of life. Cannabidiol (CBD), a non‐psychoactive compound derived from Cannabis sativa , has been investigated for its anti‐inflammatory, antioxidant, and regenerative properties, suggesting potential therapeutic applications in wound healing.
